title: Private Internet Access (PIA VPN) 105% Cashback on 1-Month, 6-Month & 2-Year Plans for New PIA Customers @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Private Internet Access (PIA VPN) 105% Cashback on 1-Month, 6-Month & 2-Year Plans for New PIA Customers @ TopCashback AU

[glade90] The service is owned by Kape Technologies, a British-Israeli cybersecurity firm headquartered in Tel Aviv.
This is anything but private internet.
[TerryTightwad] Sounds like a good one. I'll give it a whirl!
[trixieb] Australian Dollars (estimate) as stated on the PIA website via TopCashback AU.
PIA seems to report in USD to TopCashback AU as there appears to be a currency conversion fee (USD to AUD) with the cashback that is reflected in your TopCashback AU account (similar to other VPN cashback offers via TopCashback AU).
I wrote in the post:
The tracked amount in your TopCashback account will be slightly lower than what you are charged. This is probably due to the currency conversion fees/taxes as Private Internet Access reports to TopCashback in USD which is converted to AUD. 105% cashback minus the fees/taxes.
[TerryTightwad] Anyone else having problems paying? I have tried paypal with multiple cards, and manual payment and it says declined.
[trixieb] Try changing your email and it may work. Some of the payment rejections with the VPN companies are due to the system rejecting the email. I had a similar experience and it worked after changing my email.
[TerryTightwad] Thanks, tried many email addresses and many cards. Thought it was a card problem but its just happening with every email and card.
[trixieb] That's odd. Did you use TopCashback app to PIA website, mobile data and Chrome browser?
[TerryTightwad] @trixieb: Tried only on PC so far, various browsers. Will try the app.
[trixieb] Please note ExpressVPN currently does not offer the 30-day money-back guarantee.
If your purchase does not track, you cannot ask for a refund from ExpressVPN. With missing cashback claims for VPN orders, there is a risk cashback could be rejected.
[TerryTightwad] Thanks for the heads up, was very tempted until I saw this comment!
[trixieb] Also available: CyberGhost VPN: 120% Cashback on 1-Month, 6-Month & 2-Year Plans for New CyberGhost VPN Customers @ TopCashback AU Expires 14/07 11:59pm AEST.
[brisneylander] I was half way through a 2 year subscription when I found out about it's ownership. Uninstalled immediately
[TerryTightwad] Worked with Mobile Data and phone app, with Chrome but still not tracked. $50.80 tracked. Cost $0.94
